materials.emptyBody: The materials you buy will be here: how much you hold of each, where it's kept and when to order more.
materials.conversionHint: How many of the unit it's counted in make one of the unit it's bought in.
materials.unitWeightHint: Only for ingredient lists and fragrance allergens, which list by weight. Leave it blank if you don't know.
materials.inventoriableHint: Turn this off for something you buy but don't count, such as a tool.

bases.emptyBody: What you make from materials and use in other {{recipes}} will be here, such as a spice blend or a syrup.

products.emptyBody: The products you sell will be here, with their variations, pictures and stock.
products.priceHint: Leave it blank to sell it at the product's default price.
products.conversionHint: How many of it come in one of the unit it's bought in.
products.imagePrompt: Drop a GIF, JPEG, PNG or WebP picture of up to 5 MB here.
products.changedInStore: This product changed in {{store}} since you opened it, so nothing was saved. Its newest version is shown now: save again to write over it.
products.listed: It's listed in {{store}}. Archive it instead, which archives it in {{store}} too, or delete it in {{store}} first.
products.listedArchived: It's listed in {{store}}. Delete it in {{store}} first, which removes its listing.

profit.title: Profitability
profit.hint: Revenue is what order lines charged after their discounts, less refunds and returns, without shipping or tax. An order counts once it ships, at what its stock cost when it went out. Wholesale is what a company bought through the store.
profit.uncosted_one: {{count}} shipment line went out with no cost, so the cost is too low.
profit.uncosted_other: {{count}} shipment lines went out with no cost, so the cost is too low.
profit.leftOut_one: {{count}} order in another currency isn't counted.
profit.leftOut_other: {{count}} orders in another currency aren't counted.

pricing.title: Cost and price
pricing.noCost: It has never had a cost, so its margin is unknown.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Every cost and price in Hoard is in this currency.
currency.codeHint: Three letters, such as USD or EUR.

words.title: Words
words.description: What Hoard calls a base and a recipe on every page, such as a blend or a formula. Leave one empty for Hoard's own word.
words.recipeHint: Such as formula or bill of materials.

units.title: Units
units.empty: No units of your own yet. Add the ones Hoard doesn't know, such as a jar or a bag.
units.name: Unit

categories.title: Categories
categories.typeHint: A category can name the type a record made in it takes, which can still be changed. A new default type changes no record's type.
categories.defaultType: Type a new record in {{name}} takes

types.title: Types
types.hint: A type decides the page its records are shown on: which fields it shows, and where. It never changes what a record does, and a field its page hides still counts. Lay out a type's page from the page of one of its records.

labourRate.title: Labour rate
labourRate.description: What an hour of work costs. {{Recipes}} cost their minutes at this rate.
labourRate.hint: Leave it blank to cost no labour.

overhead.title: Overhead
overhead.description: What running the business adds to what goods cost, such as rent and power, as a share of the goods and labour. A product's cost, and its margin, count it.
overhead.hint: Leave it blank to add no overhead.

errors.IN_USE: Records still use it, so it can't be deleted.
errors.MAIN_LOCATION: The main location can't be deleted.
errors.LAST_VARIATION: A product keeps at least one variation.
errors.IMAGE_TYPE: Add a GIF, JPEG, PNG or WebP picture.
errors.IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: That picture is larger than 5 MB.
errors.LISTED_IN_STORE: It's listed in a synced store. Archive the product instead, or delete it in the store first.
errors.STORE_PRODUCT_CHANGED: This product changed in the store since you opened it, so nothing was saved. Its newest version is shown now.
errors.TRACKING_UNIT_IN_STOCK: Its stock movements already count in this unit, so it stays. If all it has is its starting stock, delete that adjustment first.
errors.TRACKING_UNIT_IN_PURCHASES: A purchase already counts it in this unit, so it stays.
errors.TRACKING_UNIT_IN_STOCKTAKES: A stocktake already counted it in this unit, so it stays.
errors.TRACKING_UNIT_IN_RECIPES: A {{recipe}} already uses it in this unit, so it stays.
errors.TRACKING_UNIT_IN_OWN_RECIPE: Its {{recipe}} already makes it in this unit, so it stays.
errors.TRACKING_UNIT_IN_RUNS: A run already makes or uses it in this unit, so it stays.
errors.UNIT_STANDARD: Hoard's standard units can't be renamed or deleted.
errors.NOT_INVENTORIABLE: That material carries no stock, so it can't start with any.
errors.SHAPE_UNKNOWN: That page shape isn't one Hoard ships for this kind of record.
errors.TYPE_DEFAULT: Each kind keeps its default type. Rename it instead.
errors.CONSIGNEE_CONTACT: A consignee's location needs its contact, and the main location can't be one.
errors.CONSIGNEE_MAPPED: A store sells this location's stock. Unmap it from the store first.
errors.TRANSFER_LOT_ELSEWHERE: That lot isn't at the location it's moving from.
errors.TRANSFER_OVER_BALANCE: That's more than is there to move.
errors.LOT_REQUIRED: Name the lot to move: this category records every lot.

items.noStock: Nothing on hand at any location yet.
items.removeBody: Its stock, lots and adjustments go with it.
items.cureDaysHint: What a run makes waits on hold, curing, this long.
items.picturePrompt: Drop a GIF, JPEG, PNG or WebP picture of up to 5 MB here.
items.pictureReplace: Drop another picture here to replace it.

bin.title: Bin
bin.hint: Leave every part blank to clear the bin.

start.title: Where it starts
start.unitCostHint: What one of it cost. Leave it blank if you don't know.

move.title: Move stock
move.hint: It moves at its average cost. A lot keeps its number, and its hold, at the other location. To undo a move, move the stock back.

history.noRunsMade: No run has made it yet.
history.noRunsUsed: No run has used it yet.
history.noAdjustments: Nothing has moved its stock yet.
history.noStocktakes: No stocktake has counted it yet.
history.noOrders: No order has sold it yet.
history.noPurchases: No purchase has bought it yet.
